page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1.14xlarge is a big data-focused virtual server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 56 dedicated vCPUs from an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor operating at 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The system includes 224.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU.

A key characteristic of this instance is its dense bundled local storage capacity, consisting of 165356 GB across mechanical hard disk drives (HDD). Network connectivity provides a baseline bandwidth of 17 Gbps. The server operates without discrete GPU accelerators, and complimentary public IPv4 addresses are not included.

The inclusion of massive HDD capacity emphasizes cost-efficient storage density for large sequential data volumes over low-latency random access. The primary architectural tradeoff is the mechanical storage medium, which prioritizes bulk capacity per resource unit while exhibiting higher seek latency and lower IOPS compared to NVMe or standard SSD alternatives.

The hardware configuration is suited for distributed big data infrastructure, including Apache Hadoop data nodes, Apache Spark analytics with heavy intermediate disk writes, centralized log ingestion platforms, and large-scale extract-transform-load (ETL) processing.

This hardware profile matches large-scale distributed analytics, Hadoop clusters, high-capacity file ingestion systems, and batch data transformation workflows.
